Question 3
?

The equation x2−4x+4=1 can be written in the form (x+p)2=q. Find p−q, and the sum of the roots x1+x2.

a
p−q=−3,x1+x2=2
b
p−q=−2,x1+x2=3
c
p−q=3,x1+x2=4
d
p−q=−3,x1+x2=4
e
p−q=3,x1+x2=−4
